title: Quantum Entanglement Explained
description: Explore the strange connection of quantum entanglement, where measuring one particle determines the state of its twin across any distance. Learn how quantum mechanics describes this fascinating phenomenon.
hook: Two particles can share a single, connected reality across the universe.
narration: Two particles can share a single, connected reality across the universe. When you measure one particle, you determine the exact state of its twin. It does not matter if the twin is across the room or across the galaxy. Albert Einstein famously called this spooky action at a distance. Modern quantum mechanics successfully explains how this connection works through mathematics, even though it defies our everyday logic. They remain linked as a single system. Nature is far stranger than it appears.
